properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Verify that all assertions are satisfied in the program.
Ensure that the output O is always a non-negative integer.
Ensure that the output O is 1 if N is less than or equal to 2.
Ensure that the program does not enter an infinite loop.
Ensure that the output O is equal to the sum of the previous two Fibonacci numbers if N is greater than 2, unless saturation occurs.

pattern_params.1: instance.N >= 0 AND instance.N <= 30 AND instance.N > 2 AND instance.O < 32767

properties_to_be_validated.property_description: Ensure that the output O and intermediate values do not exceed 32767.
Ensure that if overflow occurs, the output O is set to the maximum allowable value of 32767.

pattern_params.1: instance.N >= 0 AND instance.N <= 30 AND (instance.O > 32767 OR instance.O < 0)
